The context manager acquires the lock, yields the file handle, and releases the lock on exit.
```python
class FileLock:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
    def __enter__(self):
        self._fd = open(self.path, 'rb+')
        fcntl.flock(self._fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        return self._fd
    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        fcntl.flock(self._fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        self._fd.close()
```
